LESSON: COMMUNITY LEADERSHIP

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Citizenship and Governance in Kenya
Topic 5.6: Community Leadership

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Community Leadership. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: LEARN

COMMUNITY LEADERS IN THE COUNTY Welcome to a social studies lesson for grade 4 learners. Today, we are going to learn about community leaders in the county.

Today, we are going to learn about community leaders in the county. Learner, mention any leader you know in Kenya. Mention any leader you know in Kenya. #Bell# Good. I hope your answers include; Our president The governor of your county The Senators The chief of your area, and Religious leaders in your area. Religious leaders in your area. Who is a leader? #Bell# A leader is the head of a group who share the same interests and goals. A leader is the head of a group who share the same interests and goals. In unit one. We learned that Kenya is divided into 47 counties. Learner of the 47 counties, which is your county. Which is your county? #Bell# Who is the governor of your county? Who is the governor of your county? #Bell# Very well, there are different types of leaders in the community. Community leaders lead people in a community. They are very important. Who are the community leaders in your community? Who are the community leaders in your community? #Bell# Good. Different communities have leaders who guide them. Such leaders include; Council of Elders. Chiefs Cultural leaders and Religious leaders. Let us talk about the Council of Elders in some of the communities here in Kenya. Does your community have a council of elders? Does your community have a council of elders? #Bell# A council of elders represents the interests of the community. They also help to find solutions to the challenges faced by the people they lead.

The Council of Elders have the following responsibilities. They settle disputes among the community members. When people living in the community had a disagreement, the Council of Elders would intervene and solve the issues. They are peacemakers in the community, The Council of Elders made sure that community, customs and practices that foster harmony,order and peace are passed on to the next generation. The elders are teachers. They teach the young about moral values like peace, Justice, humility, truthfulness, cooperation, unity and many other values. Elders are instrumental in creating a harmonious relationship between people and God. Elders unite community members. They helped in conservation of the environment. Trees were not cut down unnecessarily. Some of the communities that have the Council of Elders include; The Ameru The Agikuyu The Luo council of elders. The luo council of elders. Who is your religious leader? Who is your religious leader? #Bell# Religious leaders are also important leaders in the community. Sheiks and imams are leaders of the Muslim community. They lead the Islamic worship services. Bishops, priests and pastors are leaders of the Christian community. They lead Christian worship services. What are the duties of community leaders in your county? What are the duties of community leaders in your county? #Bell# Good. Some of the duties of community leaders in the community include; They unite the community they lead. They unite the community they lead. They maintain law and order thus promoting peace and harmony. They maintain law and order, thus promoting peace and harmon They care and protect the interests and welfare of all their members. They care and protect the interests and welfare of all their members. Community leaders resolve disputes among members. Community leaders resolve disputes among members. They encourage cooperation among the members of the community. They encourage cooperation among the members of the community. They promote security among the members of the community. They promote security among the members of the community. To conclude the lesson with the help of your parents or guardians. Tell your friends three things that your community leaders are doing to prevent the spread of corona virus in your community. And with that, we come to the end of our lesson for today. Until next time. Goodbye.

[ ] Your radio teacher was Esther Simaloi. The program was written and produced by the It was recorded by Johnson Mwangi for the Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development. Until next time. Goodbye. [ ]

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Community Leadership means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Community Leadership.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER

1. Topic: Community Leadership
2. Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
3. Learning materials: PROGRAMME_7 COMMUNITY LEADERS IN THE COUNTY; PROGRAMME_8 QUALITIES OF A GOOD LEADER IN THE COMMUNITY; SST_PROGRAMME_11 CHILD ABUSE IN THE COMMUNITY.
4. Revise with the quiz now.
